audit.why: Emerald+ 56.06% over 899 games matches the FAV / 6-10 framing: Olaf owns levels 1-6, Ryze owns the two-item mark.
audit.corrected: Kept diff FAV and diffRating 6/10; only the two-item row was wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both spike text and the level chart credited Ryze with a shield he does not have, and the full layer said Olaf wins at 2+ items while the packet chart and the content layer say Ryze.
audit.why: Ryze's kit is Arcane Mastery / Overload / Rune Prison / Spell Flux / Realm Warp — no shield ability exists. His scaling spike is Overload reset chaining, not a shield.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read Overload resets + Flux-primed Rune Prison; phases[6].side flipped to Ryze to match win[6] and the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly described a 'Q/E/W root chain' and 'Q root, E root, W root'. Only Rune Prison (W) applies CC, and it roots ONLY when Spell Flux (E) is already on the target — otherwise it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot text: Rune Prison 'slows their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' That makes dodging Spell Flux (615 range) the whole defensive game, and it makes Ragnarok's disable immunity a counter to exactly one ability.
audit.corrected: Rewrote early/mid/late, whys[2/4/6], spikes[1]/[3] and wants.foe to name Spell Flux as the root primer and Rune Prison (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 615 range) as the single lockdown Ragnarok answers.

audit.why: Rune Prison at 11s rank 1 is the punishable window; existing cooldown copy already keys engages to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] was headed 'E true damage on cooldown' but its body described baiting Rune Prison.
audit.why: The body did not support its own trigger, so the reader got no reason to press E.
audit.corrected: Body now states Reckless Swing costs no mana and ignores MR, on an 11s cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Ryze flips it: Overload resets and Flux-primed Rune Prison kite you out. Carry threat 8.5/10 — close before he free-casts.

edits.before: Your axe-reset slow sticks him for the E nuke before his E-Q root combo can set up a kill.
edits.after: Your axe slow sticks him for the E nuke before Spell Flux into Rune Prison can root you.

edits.before: Ragnarok makes you immune to his Q/E/W root chain, so you dive straight through his only defense.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes you immune to Rune Prison, his only lockdown, so you dive straight through his defense.

edits.before: He out-scales hard: his Q reset chain, shield and W-root let him kite and burst you once he has two items.
edits.after: He out-scales hard: Overload resets and Flux-primed Rune Prison let him kite and burst you once he has two items.

edits.before: Ragnarok makes you immune to his Q-E-W root chain, so you walk through every point of his CC and all-in him uncontested.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes you immune to Rune Prison — his only hard CC — so from 6 you walk through his lockdown and all-in him uncontested.

edits.before: Once Ryze hits 2+ items his rotating Q resets and shield out-DPS you — he kites with W-root and bursts you before you reach him.
edits.after: Once Ryze hits 2+ items his Overload resets out-DPS you — Spell Flux into Rune Prison roots you at 615 range and he bursts you from there.

edits.before: Ryze can't kill you early — his Q poke and E-into-Q root combo cost a lot of mana and don't out-damage your sustain. At level 1 your Q-slow into an auto wins first contact, and by 2-3 you have Q plus E to land a guaranteed true-damage nuke he simply can't match. Dodge his E (the root primer) so his Q can't follow up; if he burns it on minions, walk up and throw Q, then E him. Don't let his slows kite you off the wave.
edits.after: Ryze can't kill you early — his Overload poke and E-into-W root combo cost a lot of mana and don't out-damage your sustain. At level 1 your Q-slow into an auto wins first contact, and by 2-3 you have Q plus E to land a guaranteed true-damage nuke he can't match. Dodge Spell Flux — with no Flux on you, Rune Prison only slows; if he burns E on minions, walk up, throw Q, then E him. Don't let his slows kite you off the wave.

edits.before: This is your takeover window. Chase him with axe resets to perma-slow, W on for omnivamp to heal his poke back, and E for true damage that ignores his shield value. At 6 Ragnarok is the trump card: pop it and his entire kit — Q root, E root, W root — does nothing to stop you, so you all-in or tower-dive him through his peel. Force every fight here; his only out is flashing his root and praying for jungle.
edits.after: This is your takeover window. Chase him with axe resets to perma-slow, W on for omnivamp to heal his poke back, and E for true damage that ignores his magic resist. At 6 Ragnarok is the trump card: pop it and Rune Prison — his one piece of lockdown, 11s at rank 1 — cannot stop you, so all-in or tower-dive him. Force every fight here; his only out is flashing the root and praying for jungle.

edits.before: From two items on, Ryze becomes the problem. His rotating Q resets and overload chain start to out-DPS your flat true damage, his W-root and shield let him survive your gap-close, and he kites you from range while his realm warp roams the map. Your job is to have already won — convert your early-to-mid lead into towers, plates and dives before ~20-25 min. If it goes long, group with your team and look to dive him before he gets to free-cast; never duel a full-build Ryze alone.
edits.after: From two items on, Ryze becomes the problem. His Overload resets and Flux chain start to out-DPS your flat true damage, Spell Flux into Rune Prison roots you at 615 to break your gap-close, and he kites you while Realm Warp repositions his team. Your job is to have already won — convert your early-to-mid lead into towers, plates and dives before ~20-25 min. If it goes long, group with your team and look to dive him before he gets to free-cast; never duel a full-build Ryze alone.

edits.before: Land his E-then-Q root combo to lock you out of melee range and poke you
edits.after: Land Spell Flux then Rune Prison to root you out of melee range and poke you

edits.before: Use his W-root and shield to survive your all-in and stall to 2+ items
edits.after: Use his Flux-primed root to break your all-in and stall to 2+ items

edits.before: Ryze wastes Rune Prison — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Reckless Swing costs no mana and ignores MR — chip every 11s.

notes: Ryze has no shield ability anywhere in his kit; three separate fields claimed one. Also the full layer said Olaf wins at 2+ items while win[6] and the packet chart both said Ryze — flipped phases[6].side to Ryze (win[6] was already correct, so no paired content edit was needed). Whether Ragnarok cleanses an already-applied Rune Prison root or only prevents new ones is not in Riot's text, so no text asserts it either way.
